expected_level_description: You can: - run an HR administration service, checking quality and meeting service standards - improve processes and templates, and automate routine steps where you can - resolve complex or unusual cases, such as overpayments or contract errors
You can: - apply people policies to routine cases and explain them to managers - identify the employment law principles behind a policy - keep policy records and track policy review dates

You can: - advise managers on straightforward cases and the next step in a procedure - support investigations, prepare case papers, and arrange hearings - work constructively with staff representatives on individual cases
You can: - run standard workforce reports and check them for errors - answer routine information requests about the workforce
You can: - explain how pay bands, increments, and allowances work - explain that jobs are banded by job evaluation, not by the person in the job
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly

You can: - listen to the needs of design and business stakeholders and interpret information - take part in discussions within a multidisciplinary team - be an advocate for the team externally, and can manage differing perspectives - shape and share communications relevant to the audience
You can: - recognise and challenge behaviour that excludes others - consider different needs when you plan your work
